svg.title: CUDA batches augmentation views by canvas shape
svg.desc: RF-DETR Small groups native-scale and 0.85 views on 544-pixel canvases and uses separate 640- and 768-pixel canvases for the larger zooms. The groups have 2, 1 and 1 rows for one image and 16, 8 and 8 rows for eight images. Results are mapped back and fused in input order.
svg.text: RF-DETR Small on CUDA: group views by canvas size

g.text: V = 4 views of the same image, each placed on its own canvas
map back to the image, average the matching boxes

svg.text: predict(8 images): 32 rows across the same three canvas groups
